digest.component_or_area: review-bot Gerrit webhook and retrigger system
propositions: A contributor cannot trigger a re-review when the current revision carries a real LLM-Review finding BLOCK; only coverage-gap sub-reasons and escalated verdicts are eligible for retrigger.
The recheck-review Gerrit comment must reset the per-revision attempts budget and enqueue a forced re-review through the existing _rebar_force path, bypassing dedup and existing-vote short-circuits.

The tag parser must classify all three production tag shapes: _TAG_SUFFIXES members, the hardcoded merge-review literal, and tags with in-bracket (merge-change, N) suffixes; unparseable or absent tags are treated as eligible (fail-open to fresh fail-closed review).
The retrigger eligibility decision is made privileged-side from durable Gerrit LLM-Review vote MESSAGE state, never from contributor-controlled comment text, to prevent forging of tag values.
The reply comment path must post only a message body with no labels key in the Gerrit REST call, ensuring no vote displacement or label state change.
Bot-authored comments and comments lacking the recheck-review token are no-ops with no reply or enqueue; the /rerun operator endpoint harmonizes by resetting attempts budget before enqueueing.
